title: Dancing at clubs, the Lincoln Theater and Bourbon Street
summary: They danced at the Cotton Club and Lincoln Theater and for money on Bourbon Street before he switched to playing music.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: So where would you all perform in town?
Well like I say we performed around Cotton Club, Poles Inn, New York Inn.
Did you do any of the big theaters? I mean I know Lincoln Theater was open at that time. Did you perform at the Lincoln?
Yeah, at the Lincoln, during the time I played at the Palace of Lincoln I was playing music then. I switched from dancing. But we used to dance all up and down Bourbon.
Would you dance for money, on the street for money?
That's what the idea is. Well they still do that. Yeah.
You see that guy in Bourbon Street? I forget his name. There's some guy, he's great.
Is that guy in Port Shop? Ah, that might be him. His name is Isaac Mason.
What's his name in a couple of days? He's great. Yeah, I was never even seen him.
You find your best dancers out there. Yeah, yeah, yeah.
